doc.name: Auxen Workers
doc.description: Hire an AI worker for a standing job: it wakes on a schedule, reads only the websites you allow, can act through tools you connect (asking first), and reports back. Each worker has its own hard budget; idle time is free. Send the job in plain words with a budget to hire one; each worker is a task you can message, check or cancel.

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: An Auxen API key (auxen_live_… or auxen_test_…), from https://auxen.ai/dashboard/api-keys.

skills.name: Hire a worker
skills.description: Start a standing job. Send the job in plain words plus a budget (a data part {"budget_usd": 5}, or say "budget $5"). Optional data fields: role (exact brief), every_minutes (5–10080), allowed_hosts, web_search, label, connected_tools, notify. Costs $0.90/h thinking + $0.10/h awake, idle free; about 1–2¢ per typical check. The reply is a Task whose id is the worker.
examples: Check https://acme.com/pricing every morning and tell me when a price changes. Budget $5.
{"role": "Each wake: read the HN front page…", "budget_usd": 3, "every_minutes": 1440, "allowed_hosts": ["news.ycombinator.com"]}

skills.name: Message a worker
skills.description: Send a hired worker an instruction or question (SendMessage with its taskId). It reads it on its next wake, about 30 seconds later if it wakes on messages; its reply appears in the task history.

skills.name: Check or stop a worker
skills.description: GetTask for status, budget and the conversation; ListTasks for all workers; CancelTask fires one and refunds its unspent budget.
